exposure: packed red blood cells transfusion status
outcome: frequency of packed red blood cells transfusion
cohort: The study included 335 premature infants admitted to the Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Shahid Sadoughi Hospital, Yazd, Iran during 2016.
finding: 25.4% of preterm infants received packed red blood cell transfusions, and those who received transfusions had a significantly lower mean age and mean Apgar score, with a substantial volume of blood being wasted.
